End the coaching link. The athlete keeps their history and account; they can join a
coach again through an invite.

Email a sign-in code. The same answer whether or not the email has an account.

ticket (valid 30 minutes) for coach sign-up or joining through an invite.
New tokens for a refresh token (from the body, or the web app's cookie).

post.description:
A new invite. With an email the link is sent; `email_sent` false means it failed and
can be resent (the invite and its link still work).

get.description: What a new athlete can start on: the gym's templates and saved weeks.
What an invite link is for, before joining.

post.description: Join as the signed-in account (an athlete without a coach, or a new athlete profile).

Join as a new account, for an email verified by `auth/email/verify` (its ticket).
Answers with the new account's tokens, like signing in.

get.description:
The signed-in person and their profiles: a coach (with their gym), an athlete (with
their coach), or both. An athlete without a coach has `coach_name` null.

The coach's athletes, sorted (attention, name, compliance, competition) and filtered
by name or email.
